historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; correctly adds Type 3 resolution and topology evidence but misclassifies approval and baseline provisioning as manual execution.

original_test_intent: Verify the Chassis Handle in the intended SMBIOS Type 2 record is a valid reference to the approved Type 3 chassis record and that this relationship persists after reboot.
original_method: Capture all Type 2 and Type 3 structures with their handles, select the intended baseboard, normalize its Chassis Handle, resolve that handle to exactly one expected Type 3 record, reboot and revalidate the same semantic relationship rather than only comparing an opaque number.
manual_activity: A user approves the target board/chassis relationship and reboot plan. Pointer extraction, resolution, comparison and persistence checking are automatable.
required_inputs: Expected Type 2 board to Type 3 chassis relationship
Target board/chassis identity and BOM mapping
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only and retain complete Type 2/Type 3 structures and errors.
Resolve the handle; a syntactically valid hexadecimal value alone is not acceptance evidence.
Reject dangling, duplicate, wrong-type or wrong-chassis targets and do not assume the first record.
Compare semantic relationships across reboot because numeric handles may legitimately be regenerated only if project policy permits.
Stop on ambiguity or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect every relevant structure/handle, bind the target Type 2 record, resolve its Chassis Handle to Type 3, compare with the approved topology and repeat after reboot.
Do not modify SMBIOS, infer an unapproved mapping or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the intended board-to-chassis relationship and whether numeric-handle stability or semantic-target stability is required.
Resolve dangling or changed references and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Insufficient as authoritative evidence because an isolated handle is an internal reference, grep loses the referenced Type 3 structure and record provenance, errors are suppressed and transport assumptions are insecure.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete `dmidecode -t 2` and `-t 3` output with errors/tool version, parse structure handles and resolve the selected Type 2 pointer to exactly one Type 3 record.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Chassis Handle scope, linked Type 2 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Model SMBIOS structures as a handle graph, require the target Type 2 Chassis Handle to resolve uniquely to the approved Type 3 node, and compare both raw pointer and semantic chassis identity before/after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS, chassis and BOM revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 2/Type 3 handle semantics and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Validates reference integrity and target identity instead of treating a printed handle as a standalone value.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Raw handle numbers are identifiers within a table instance; semantic identity may be more meaningful than numeric stability across firmware changes.

project_override_considerations: A project may require exact numeric-handle persistence or only resolution to the same approved chassis identity; the selected policy must be explicit and must never allow a dangling or wrong-type reference.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected board/chassis relationship, handle policy and tool versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 2/Type 3 structures plus resolution graph
Complete post-reboot pointer and semantic-target comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Type 2 pointer field and persistence criterion are coherent; the source's brevity does not create competing semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Pointer resolution is well defined and read-only. Expected relationship and stability policy are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Extends the read from isolated text to complete pointer resolution.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains Type 3 collection and topology safety while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Explicitly distinguishes raw numeric-handle persistence from semantic referential integrity.

review_improvement: Prevents a nonzero but dangling or wrong-chassis handle from being reported as correct and avoids false drift when only handle numbering changes under an approved policy.
independent_technical_reasoning: All core graph extraction, resolution and reboot comparison steps are software-controlled after the expected relationship is approved; no human physical manipulation is part of the source case.
